class.name: JRPGPartyAmountCommand
class.brief_description: The base of the event commands that change the party's gold and items by an amount.
class.description: Holds what [JRPGChangeGoldCommand] and [JRPGChangeItemsCommand] (and its weapon and armor versions) change things by: [member amount], or the value of variable [member variable_id] when [member amount_is_variable] (an integer; a float is cut to one; text is 0), added on [constant OPERATION_INCREASE] and taken away on [constant OPERATION_DECREASE]. A negative amount works the other way. Authority: server.

members.member: The amount, when it is not read from a variable.
The amount is variable [member variable_id]'s value.
Whether the amount is added or taken away.
The variable the amount is read from.
